description: Physiological safety keeps me grounded and aware #safety #stressrelief #selflove
transcript: Physiological safety is so important to me. That is the number one thing that I prioritize because I don't have the luxury of losing control. I do not have the luxury of spiraling out. I have to maintain my internal world. I have to create protection. I have to fine tune. I have to pay attention. I have to be aware. I have to keep me internally safe.
